source.origin: logikbench upstream TX (ofdm_tx.v + fft.v concatenated) at N=32/CP=8; the only edits are two RTLScout-marked one-line localparam corrections (LAT 70->37 measured, LOG2N 6->$clog2(N)) for values hardcoded to N=64 upstream, and one RTLScout-marked structural fix that replicates the cyclic-prefix symbol-capture enable; the original code is retained in comments and the same fixes are applied to the recast design
source.design: upstream NATIVE interface: one in_valid pulse per symbol (192-bit payload + mod), modulated symbol streamed out as I/Q beats; native schedule metered per case (reset release -> out_last), no memory port
source.oracle: same 21 jobs and goldens as ofdm32_mod_1r1w (vectors.dat byte-identical, stride 93); TB checks the 80 streamed I/Q words per case against the goldens
source.purpose: the upstream's own ARP under the study flow, for the upstream comparison -- a measurement vehicle, not an agent-optimization benchmark
